Hi Raj / Asha -

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned:

1) Scope & compliance questions
   - You asked about Redwood's SOC 2 status, scope, and whether our controls cover hosted API and Dedicated deployments.
   - You also raised GDPR applicability for EU customer data and HIPAA for one pilot use-case.

2) Incident response / breach notification
   - You want our incident response timelines, notification commitments, and whether we can provide BCP/DR evidence (runbooks, RTO/RPO, tabletop reports).

3) Documents we'll share (next 48 hours)
   - SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) - high level and control mapping.
   - BCP/DR executive summary & tabletop report template.
   - Vendor security questionnaire (we can pre-fill common fields).

4) Next calls
   - IR deep-dive with your security operations lead (proposed Wed 11/19 10:30am PT).
   - Follow-up to walk through pre-filled questionnaire (if useful) after you review materials.

Action items (who):
- Soojin: Share SOC 2 redacted + BCP exec summary and the vendor questionnaire stub (TODAY).
- Jordan: Standby for IR deep-dive and to cover deployment isolation questions for Dedicated.
- Raj / Asha: Confirm whether HIPAA applies to the pilot and whether you prefer secure upload or SFTP for evidence.

I'll upload the files to a secure folder and send a link here.

Best,
Soojin

Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Raj Patel <raj@fintechcorp.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCorp security discovery — SOC 2 / IR / BCP next steps

Thanks Soojin - good recap. A few clarifications:

- SOC 2: We need the most recent Type II and a control mapping to our scope (data at rest/encryption, access controls, change management). Redactions are fine but please call out control IDs.
- HIPAA: Yes - the pilot will process PHI in a limited scope (claims ingestion). We need confirmation that Redwood will sign a BAA and a list of applicable controls.
- GDPR: We'll have a separate privacy review, but please note whether data residency/processing locations can be restricted for EU customers.

For incident response: we need your standard breach notification timeline (detection -> internal escalation -> customer notification) and any SLA for notification windows. Also helpful: an anonymized tabletop drill summary if available.

Prefer secure upload (SCP or SFTP) to our intake host; if you can provide a pre-signed GCS/Drive link with limited access and expiry that also works.

Confirming IR deep-dive Wed 11/19 10:30am PT works for our security ops lead (Asha) and me.

-Raj
Head of Security | FinTechCorp
raj@fintechcorp.com

Looping in to provide the documents Soojin mentioned. Attached are:
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (redacted) - contains control IDs and scope notes.
- BCP-DR-Plan-exec-summary.pdf - executive summary and RTO/RPO details.
- Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-FinTechCorp.xlsx - blank questionnaire + a pre-fill tab with common answers.

Notes / answers to your points:
- SOC 2 scope covers our hosted API and Hosted Dedicated control environment. Private on-prem (customer-managed) is out of scope for the report; we've noted which controls apply to private deployments in the control mapping section (see SOC2 report appendix B).
- HIPAA / BAA: We can sign a BAA. We'll route that through legal - expect a draft within 72 hours after you confirm scope.
- GDPR / Data residency: We support region-based routing for EU processing; we'll call out regions and associated data-at-rest storage in the mapping doc.

Attachments are uploaded to a secure folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-fintech-evidence (expiry: 7 days). If you prefer SFTP, Jordan can coordinate credentials.

Regards,
Marissa Cole | Director, Trust & Compliance
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa - and Raj / Asha, confirming next steps and adding logistics for the IR deep-dive tomorrow:

- IR deep-dive Wed 11/19 10:30am PT (Google Meet link in calendar invite).
- Pre-read: SOC2 redacted + BCP exec summary + pre-fill questionnaire (links above). Please review the pre-fill tab in the questionnaire before the call - we'll walk through gaps.
- BAA: Marissa - noted legal will draft and route. Raj - once you confirm pilot scope, please reply-all with the specific data types and systems involved so legal has the right context.

Secure upload preference acknowledged: I'll provide an expiring Drive link (already shared) and we'll stand by to SFTP if you want.

Also, a couple of incident response specifics to prepare for tomorrow:
- Notification timeline: our internal target is 72 hours for customer notification after incident confirmation for incidents affecting customer data; we escalate to affected customers sooner if we have confirmed evidence. We'll surface our detailed runbook in the IR session.
- Tabletop/sample: we'll share an anonymized tabletop summary in the IR call and a redacted PDF afterwards.

If anything changes on timing please flag - otherwise see you tomorrow.

Best,
Soojin

-Raj
